meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 在指定群组可用 OpenAI 的 Codex 作为 agent 后端,替代或并列于 Claude,负责规划、工具调用、MCP 工具、服务端历史与会话恢复。凭证只存于 vault。
howto.when: 你在某个群组执行 `ncl groups config update --id <群组ID> --provider codex` 并重启该群组后,该群组的对话就由 Codex 处理。默认新群组仍是 Claude,需另行设置。

say.text: 把群组 123 的 agent 提供商切换为 codex
say.note: 切换后该群组对话由 Codex 驱动。

say.text: 把默认新建群组的 agent 提供商设为 codex
say.note: 需重启主机生效,且只影响之后创建的群组。

say.text: 重新运行 codex 的认证流程
say.note: 凭证过期或缺失时更新 vault 中的密钥。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw can use OpenAI's Codex as the agent backend for selected groups, alongside or instead of Claude, handling planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history and session resume. Credentials live only in the vault.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run `ncl groups config update --id <group-id> --provider codex` for a group and restart it; that group's conversations then use Codex. New groups still default to Claude unless configured otherwise.

say_en.text: Switch group 123's agent provider to codex
say_en.note: Conversations in that group then run on Codex.

say_en.text: Set codex as the default provider for new groups
say_en.note: Requires a host restart; only affects groups created afterwards.
Updates the vault secret when credentials are missing or stale.
